paths.title: AI for Software Developers
paths.tagline: Choose, combine, and safely direct AI coding agents across your whole workflow
paths.description: A ten-lesson, cross-tool path for professional developers who work with more than one AI coding agent. Covers choosing the right tool for a task among Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot; understanding an unfamiliar repository; writing specs agents implement correctly; implementing features, debugging, and refactoring with review checkpoints; generating tests that actually catch bugs; reviewing pull requests with AI assistance; planning a migration before touching code; and setting up repository guardrails (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules, permissions) for safe team-wide agent workflows.
